cases.operator: Reverse the inclusive lower-bound comparison.
cases.witness: A child beginning after its parent must remain contained.

cases.operator: Reverse the inclusive upper-bound comparison.
cases.witness: A child ending before its parent must remain contained.

cases.operator: Reverse child and parent in permission subset evaluation.
cases.witness: A singleton child is permitted by a strict two-element parent.

cases.operator: Reverse child and parent in audience subset evaluation.
cases.witness: A singleton child is permitted by a strict two-element parent.

cases.operator: Negate permission membership.
cases.witness: A permission present in the authority set must be found.

cases.operator: Negate audience membership.
cases.witness: An audience present in the authority set must be found.

cases.operator: Negate body-digest membership.
cases.witness: A digest present in an allowed-body set must be found.

cases.operator: Reverse child and parent in body-digest subset evaluation.
cases.witness: A singleton digest set attenuates a strict two-element parent.

cases.operator: Accept a different digest for an exact-body constraint.
cases.witness: Distinct 32-byte body digests must not compare equal.

cases.operator: Accept a multi-digest allowed-body set beneath an exact-body parent.
cases.witness: A two-digest set admits more actions than an exact constraint.

cases.operator: Reject a singleton allowed-body set beneath its equivalent exact-body parent.
cases.witness: Allowed({d}) and Exact(d) admit the same canonical body digest.

cases.operator: Reverse the numeric budget ceiling comparison.
cases.witness: A lower child ceiling attenuates a higher parent ceiling.

cases.operator: Ignore the budget algebra identifier.
cases.witness: Equal numeric values from different algebras are incomparable.

cases.operator: Allow an unbounded child beneath a bounded parent.
cases.witness: None is top and cannot attenuate Some.

cases.operator: Treat a missing action budget request as an unbounded child authority.
cases.witness: No requested spend is covered by every authority ceiling.

cases.operator: Reverse the maximum status age comparison.
cases.witness: A fresher child requirement attenuates a less-fresh parent.

cases.operator: Ignore the status method identifier.
cases.witness: Snapshot policies from different methods are incomparable.

cases.operator: Ignore the profile version.
cases.witness: The same profile identifier at two versions is not exact.

cases.operator: Treat distinct assurance policy identifiers as equal.
cases.witness: Assurance attenuation requires exact policy identity.

cases.operator: Ignore changes to a critical extension payload.
cases.witness: Target V1 requires the complete canonical critical-extension set to remain exactly equal.

cases.operator: Accept equal parent and child delegation depth.
cases.witness: Every accepted child must strictly reduce remaining depth.

cases.operator: Treat distinct principals using the same DID method as equal.
cases.witness: Grant issuer linkage requires the complete principal identifier.

cases.operator: Treat any two present grant identifiers as equal.
cases.witness: Parent linkage requires the exact 32-byte grant identifier.
